title: Looks Great, But The Lights Can Come Out
text: Looks Great, But The Lights Can Come Out. I've got kids...  They take the cups out and they break them.  If they were snug in there so they were hard to take out, that would be great, but they are so loose that they fall out if the wall is hit!  Only get this if you have no kids!!
